summary.tagline: Woodland trails and shoreline meadows along the Lough.
summary.seo_title: Strangford and Lecale AONB Travel Guide

travel.headline: Castle Ward Estate Admission and Trail Access
travel.reservation: Non-members arriving by car, bike, or on foot must pay an admission fee at the entrance to the parkland. This fee supports conservation work and provides access to the multi-use trail network; check the official National Trust site for current entry status and seasonal closures.

days.title: Estate Trails and Shoreline Vistas

stops.name: Castle Ward
stops.detail: Explore 21 miles of multi-use trails through woodlands and meadows that lead down to the Strangford Lough shoreline.

days.driving: Allow 20 minutes from Downpatrick; conditions vary based on local traffic.
days.note: Cyclists and walkers must follow waymarkers in an anti-clockwise direction, while horse riders travel clockwise.

intel.title: Seasonal Grazing Closures
intel.text: The deer park area between map points 23 and 24 remains closed from March to September due to grazing cattle. Follow signposted alternative routes during these months.

intel.title: Multi-Use Trail Safety
intel.text: Designated 'slow zones' are located where trails meet to protect walkers, cyclists, and horse riders. Keep speed low in these intersections and yield to others by keeping left.

intel.title: Estate Arrival
intel.text: Parking is available on-site for a fee for non-members; evidence does not specify exact lot capacities or fill times. Verify current accessibility at the main gate upon arrival.

intel.title: Regional Services
intel.text: Evidence does not list fuel stations within the AONB boundaries. It is recommended to refuel in nearby gateway towns like Downpatrick before heading to the estate.

intel.title: Connectivity Status
intel.text: Mobile signal strength throughout the 21 miles of trails is not documented in official sources. Download trail maps before arriving at the shoreline areas.

plan.arrival: Collect a rental in Belfast or Downpatrick and head to the Castle Ward main entrance to pay the parkland admission fee.
plan.vehicle: Standard vehicles are suitable for reaching the estate; check rental terms for driving on rural Northern Ireland roads.
plan.goldenHour: Strangford Lough shoreline offers scenic views at sunset, though visibility depends on seasonal weather and cloud cover.
